headline: 🔴 Zyxel GS1900 KEV add, 🌐 BlueMoon's third actor UTA0565, 🏛️ wp2shell govt data theft, 💥 PAYLOAD encryptionless GPO ransomware, 💾 Veeam Agent exploited, 🇰🇵 Japan's first DPRK laptop farm takedown
summary: CISA's KEV added an exploited Zyxel GS1900 switch zero-click OS-command bug and a publicly PoC'd Veeam Agent flaw, while Volexity added a third Chinese actor to the BlueMoon zero-day chain and GreyNoise tied wp2shell WordPress exploitation to 49 breached organizations including a government theft of 18,566 records.

overrides.why: Today's four new events are outlet re-reports of the KEV adds already covered in the 2026-09-21 digest; no new substance.
Single event is an outlet recap of the ISE CVE-2026-76460 zero-day covered Sept 17-18 under the KEV-listed sister story; presenting it as new would break the freshness gate.
Same Volexity Mind-the-Patch-Gap-2 development (UTA0565) as today's BlueMoon delta; covered once under the canonical BlueMoon slug.
Repeats the 30,000-device / $10.71M advisory numbers already covered 2026-09-21 under WaterPlum; the genuinely new fact (Japan laptop-farm takedown) is covered via wildcard.
Sister slug whose KEV/Wiz events are July recap material; the Sept-22 GreyNoise government-breach delta is covered under canonical CVE-2026-63030 slug.
